observations: WP-10w is the REP step of the second Stage 2 Path A evidence cycle after WP-10v. It uses existing EXP-0011 for H-004 / research_oos / post_wp_5b / d2_006_gates, creates no new EXP scaffold or EXP plan, creates no OL or REC rows, and does not itself move REC-5 from 2 to 3. REC-5 remains unsatisfied until a future OL and D2 REC are separately committed. The WP-10w window is the next-most-recent contiguous equivalent-length window, 2024-04-12 through 2025-04-11, distinct from and not cloned from the REP-0012 / OL-0012 window. The actual run produced 5 of 8 D2-006 gates passing and an overall NO-GO verdict. WP-10w creates no policy, scoring, ranking/recommendation, paper/live, runtime, or protected-path authority, makes no H-004 pre/post comparison claim, and does not include H-011, H-012, Path B, cohort, EXP scaffold, or exp_success_criteria reconciliation.
diagnostic_findings: The WP-10w evidence unit is one genuine local research evaluation with a new trial id against existing EXP-0011; no new EXP was created.
The evaluation window is explicit and non-cloned: 2024-04-12 through 2025-04-11, with 365 daily bars from 2024-04-12 23:59:59.999000+00:00 through 2025-04-11 23:59:59.999000+00:00.
Indicators were warmed up on earlier available local history, and the backtest window started flat with no inherited pre-window position carry-in.
D2-006 gate results are computed from the actual WP-10w run using current post-WP-5b evaluator semantics.

The run does not create OL or REC rows and does not itself satisfy REC-5; the selected exact segment remains at two committed REC observations until future OL and REC artifacts are separately committed.
The run carries no policy, scoring, ranking/recommendation, paper/live, runtime, promotion, demotion, or protected-path authority.
